description.value: Rainbow Lodge historic cabins is a heritage attraction in Whistler's Rainbow Park, documented in Wikipedia (en:Rainbow Lodge) and significant enough to hold a Wikidata entry, indicating it is among the more historically notable sites in the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The site is managed by the Resort Municipality of Whistler and sits within the broader Rainbow Park area near Alta Lake. A touring cyclist visiting Whistler would encounter it as a cultural waypoint rather than a service stop.
